name: Infinity Nado
description:
Dawn and Athas find a mysterious sleeping boy, Pandora, who suffers from amnesia after he comes around. When Pandora just arrives at Freewheel Town, he becomes the chasing target of an organization called Ancient Hunter Group, which demands of him to carry out the "Great Mission". Under the attack of Jin and his friends, Ancient Hunter Group is temporarily repelled.

With the assistance of Jin and his friends, Pandora gradually gets used to life in this world and his skill on top is much improved.Can Pandora regain his memories? What is his "Great Mission"? The story will tell you......

videos.title: Gale's Combat Gyro
videos.overview: Jin and three other fighter Nado players come as special Nados that drop down from the sky. While looking for the owner of the special Nado, Jin comes across Dawn. Have these two met before?

videos.title: Reunion of friends
videos.overview: Jin and Dawn decide to meet Cecila to find out if she knows about the strange bond the three of them share. However, with Cecila being a famous Nado fighter, will they be able to meet her with ease?

videos.title: Nado crisis
videos.overview: Jin, Davis, Dawn and Cecila go meet Dr Louis and learn more about their Nados. However, the King family plots to attack the research lab and steal all the special equipment held there. Will Jin be able to defend Dr Louis?

videos.title: Mysterious thief Dodd
videos.overview: Phantom thief Dodd steals a powerful Nado and claims to be keeping it safe till he finds a suitable owner who can use it. Will Jin confront the mysterious thief for stealing the Thunder Stallion Nado?

videos.title: Tacit understanding test
videos.overview: Dr. Louis reveals that the spirit of Hellish Ghost has arrived on Earth and the space between dimensions is expanding and could result in the Nado's of the world getting destroyed. Furthermore Jin decides to look for Hellish ghost. Will Jin succeed?

videos.title: The King family
videos.overview: A mysterious individual makes an appearance before the King family and hands them a powerful Nado, tasking them with defeating Jin and stealing his Nado. Will Jin be able to defeat the mysterious new Nado?

videos.title: Fighting On The Highwire
videos.overview: A player from the Lengend 9, Mach Skyrider arrives in Cyclone City for a competition. Jin and the others join Mach to the arena. However, Mach seems to be hiding something from Jin and the others. Will Jin find out what Mach is hiding?

videos.title: Ultra accelerating contest
videos.overview: Jin begins to suspect that Dodd the Phantom Thief could have some connection to Hellish Ghost. However, Jin learns that Dodd is after Hellish Ghost too. Will Jin and the others join hands with Dodd to find out more about Hellish Ghost?

videos.title: First battle with flare star
videos.overview: Mach wins the competition and gets ready to leave. However, Jin begins asking Mach about the connection between Hellish Ghost and the Lengend 9. Will Mach give Jin the answers he is looking for about Hellish Ghost?

videos.title: Fight for airship
videos.overview: While Jin flies his airship with Nedo Drive Automatic system, Bill and his accomplices try to capture it mid-air with a full fledged plan. Will they be successful in their attempt?

videos.title: Union of Brothers and Sisters
videos.overview: While an overzealous Jin roams around the city with his friends, he is overwhelmed upon seeing Rachael's posters all over. Meanwhile, as he encounters her during the competition, he challenges her.

videos.title: Battled caused by cooking
videos.overview: Cecilia tells Jin that they should compete as a team to win the competition. Jin develops a new Nedo replacing the tip with "Glittering Butterfly". But still he is not sure if it is a correct defensive model to stop the Ballistic Fox. Will Jin develop a different model for that?

videos.title: Split between brother and sister
videos.overview: A tough competition takes place between Jin's Nedo with Glittering Butterfly tip and the Assaultic Fox. Rachelle is totally aback at this and puts more power to her Nedo. Will Jin be able to win this time?

videos.title: Siege of train
videos.overview: Jin, Dawn, Cecilia and Davis board a train for their next competition in Whirlpool city. Bill and his accomplices plan to siege the train after cutting off its power supply. Will Bill be successful in his evil attempt?

videos.title: The clown's magic rhapsody
videos.overview: Jin and his gang enter Whirlpool city and is amazed to se the advancement of technology there. But soon all four of them are captured by detective Jack by mistake, who is actually looking for Phantom thief. Will Jan and his team face Phantom thief?

videos.title: Ancient power
videos.overview: Eli, Dawn, Davis, and Cecilia meet a strange man named Goatson, the manager while looking for a way to face Dodd. Goatson shows them the remains of the first Nado which is believed to hold mysterious powers. Will this help them defeat Dodd?

videos.title: Counterattack of Dodd
videos.overview: After getting defeated by the Elf, Dodd comes back with a stronger and more powerful Nado to challenge him once again for a battle. Will he be able to finally beat the Elf?

videos.title: Combination of wisdom
videos.overview: Eli, Dawn, Davis, and Cecilia meet Detective Shack who is in search of a Hellish Ghost and is helping Goatson with a secret project. Eli and his friends decide to take his help and ask him to join their team. Will Shack join them?

videos.title: The scary Nado battle
videos.overview: After losing all their memories, Jin, Dawn, Davis and Cecilia seek shelter in a mansion during their journey. However, they land into trouble with some elves. Can the foursome save themselves?

videos.title: Unsteady melody
videos.overview: Jin, Dawn, Davis and Cecilia arrive at a village and meet Yvette, a violinist, during their search for the hellish ghost. Soon they realise that Yevette holds a clue to find the hellish ghost. Will they be able to get the information from him?

videos.title: Hidden scars
videos.overview: Dawn battles Vyette and Susan and takes on their deadly fusion Nado. Does Dawn have a hidden strategy to defeat two opponents or will he find himself in a tough spot?

videos.title: Adventurer in Tobin Tower
videos.overview: Jin and his friends come across Jet in an underground battle stadium and decide to challenge him. However, after Dawn gets defeated by Jet, Jin rises to the challenge and takes on Jet. Will Jin be able to win?

videos.title: Reunion Of Old Friends
videos.overview: As Jin and his friends enter Metal Town for the competition, they're chased by robots. Later, inventor Nobe greets his competitors wholeheartedly and explains to them the situation in Metal Town.

videos.title: A Lone Nado
videos.overview: Noob goes up against Cicilia in an ultimate showdown. And her friends gather to support her in the battle of a lifetime. Will Cicilia's nado emerge victoriously?

videos.title: Dominator Of Darkness
videos.overview: Noob and his gang meet a scientist in an effort to learn more about Nado and its secret components so that they can defeat their opponents with ease.

videos.title: The Truth Across Time
videos.overview: Jin finds himself in a predicament when Holy Whisker gets beat up badly in the battle, but he refuses to back down. However, he is determined to win the battle.

videos.title: The Real Identity Of Dodd
videos.overview: Jin is shaken to the core on learning that Holy Whisker has fallen into the wrong hands. So he decides to get it back at any cost. How will Jin retrieve Holy Whisker?

videos.title: Return To The Past
videos.overview: Jin inquires to his friend at the headquarters about the relationship between legging nine and Helisko. So his friend takes him to the past to show how it all began.

videos.title: The Emergence of Flare Star Nado
videos.overview: While Jun wakes up from his slumber, Dawn, Cecilia, Davis and the others are shocked to see a giant light in the skies. Upon inspection, they find an unconscious child with eight Nados protecting him. Who is this child? Find out in this episode.

videos.title: The Conflict between Jett And Mach
videos.overview: After completing one thousand battles, Jett and Mach decide to go for one more battle to see who is the best. But Jin is shocked to learn about the event. Who will win the battle?

videos.title: Little Noe on Earth
videos.overview: Little Noe wants to go back to his parallel world but Tempress Ares stands as an obstruction. How will Jin help Little Noe to go back?

videos.title: Disappearance Of Jun
videos.overview: Jin disappears and goes back seven years behind time. Nobe says that he will be forgotten soon by everyone but he offers help. How will Jin's friends bring him back?

videos.title: Break Into Another Dimension
videos.overview: Jin comes back and Bill challenges him. But he doesn't accept the challenge and starts looking for Dawn, Cecilia, Davis and others. How will Jin find out his friends?

videos.title: Lost In Amusement Park
videos.overview: Jin goes to another dimension to look for his friends and has various experiences. He finds Pandora in an amusement park and both decide to find the exit and look for their other friends. How would Jin and Pandora find out their lost friends?

videos.title: The Battle Of Meteroites
videos.overview: Jin meets Word Ares and Justice Ares who decide to teach Temperance Ares a lesson. The ask Jack about her but he refuses to open his mouth. How will they come to know about Temperance?

videos.title: The Battle Of Mechanical Planets
videos.overview: Trapped in another dimension, Dawn faces a tough opponent who uses a unique and modified version of Hellish Ghost. Will Dawn be able to defeat Temperance and escape?

videos.title: The Battle Of Water Space
videos.overview: Temperance appears before Davis in the underwater dimension and challenges him to a battle. Will Davis and his Nado be able to defeat Temperance's fusion Nado?

videos.title: The Battle Of Fire Space
videos.overview: After losing to Dawn and Davis, Temperance sets her sights on Cecelia and plans to defeat her in a Nado battle. However, will Cecelia receive help from her friends?

videos.title: The Final Battle In Another Dimension
videos.overview: Jin faces Temperance in an epic Nado battle to save Dawn, Davis and Cecelia. However, Temperance has a secret strategy to fight Jin. Can Jin defeat Temperance despite the setbacks?

videos.title: A New Journey
videos.overview: Noticing the difference in strength, Temperance mocks Jin and his power of friendship. Is this the end for Jin and his Nado? Or will his emotions give rise to new powers?

Crisis of the Sacred Nado
videos.overview: At the border marketplace between the three tribes, genius Nado mechanic Kareisha sells his self-made replicas of the Sacred Nado. However, Sergio, a young warrior from the Blazing Flame Tribe, accuses him of deception, and their dispute quickly escalates into a Nado battle. Suddenly, Sergio’s older brother Serlo appears, revealing that Sergio is hiding an important secret. Forced to escape the chaos together, Kareisha soon realizes that Sergio seems unusually familiar with the Sacred Nado. Meanwhile, the mysterious girl Lacey watches the situation unfold from the shadows, hinting that the crisis surrounding the Sacred Nado is about to begin once again.

videos.title: Lady Lacey
videos.overview: Kareisha and Sergio flee from Serlo and his followers, desperately trying to escape their pursuit. Even after entering the territory of the Sapiens Tribe, Serlo ignores the long-standing rules agreed upon by the three tribes and continues the chase. At the critical moment, Lacey, a young girl from the Thunder Dragon Tribe, suddenly appears. Using her Nado, she creates a dense water mist to provide cover, helping Kareisha and Sergio break through and escape. After regrouping, Sergio explains that his brother has fallen under the influence of Maxwell’s power. He also reveals that he stole the dark Nado, Super Demon Lord, which carries that destructive energy. Once again, Sergio pleads with Kareisha to find the true Sacred Nado to save his brother. To Kareisha’s surprise, Lacey shares the same goal. Although still cautious, Kareisha decides to team up with them for now and face the challenges ahead together.

videos.title: Sergio's Choice
videos.overview: Kareisha continues his escape in the intelligent camper vehicle together with Lacey and Sergio as they try to shake off their pursuers. Lacey once again insists that finding the true Sacred Nado is the only way to resolve the growing crisis. However, Sergio becomes increasingly conflicted. Worried about his brother, he begins to feel the influence of the dark power within Super Demon Lord, struggling with his own inner doubts. After fleeing into a forest, the trio is suddenly trapped by Serlo’s group using chain weapons. Still lacking teamwork and coordination, the three fight back using their Nados and gradually manage to repel the attackers. In the end, Kareisha cleverly comes up with a plan that allows them to escape safely. Later, moved by Lacey’s treasured possession and Sergio’s protective charm, Kareisha finally decides to officially team up with them and continue the journey together.

videos.title: The Thunder Dragon Tribe's Hunt
videos.overview: While repairing their camper vehicle, Kareisha’s team breaks into an argument due to their very different lifestyles. The cultural differences between the Sapiens Tribe, the Blazing Flame Tribe, and the Thunder Dragon Tribe become increasingly apparent. Just as the trio is about to rest, they are suddenly ambushed by Hermina, a deadly assassin from the Thunder Dragon Tribe. She openly accuses Lacey of being a traitor to her own tribe. During the intense battle, Hermina reveals a unique combat formation. After analyzing the situation, Kareisha decides that retreat is the only option. At the critical moment, Lacey delivers a decisive strike, allowing the team to escape. Afterwards, Lacey reveals the truth: internal conflict has erupted within the Thunder Dragon Tribe over the Sacred Nado, and the deputy chief has been secretly plotting a rebellion.

videos.title: Kareisha's Resolve
videos.overview: After arriving at a service area within the territory of the Sapiens Tribe, Kareisha leaves the group alone under the excuse of repairing their vehicle. Unaware of his absence, Sergio and Lacey are suddenly ambushed at a barbecue stand by Hersh, a subordinate of Maxwell. Claiming to act under a warrant issued jointly by the three tribes, Hersh attempts to seize back the dark Nado, Arcane Demon Lord, from Sergio.During the fight, Sergio bravely endures Hersh’s brutal attacks to prevent the Nado from being taken, while Lacey struggles to find a way to turn the situation around.At the most critical moment, Kareisha returns in the camper vehicle and successfully rescues his two companions. After learning the truth behind the wanted order, Kareisha finally makes up his mind to form a team with Sergio and Lacey and continue their journey together.

videos.title: Lord Hersh Arrives
videos.overview: Kareisha’s team continues to be pursued by Hersh. As their camper escapes into the forest, they use rolling logs to block his pursuit, but Hersh becomes furious after his hairstyle is ruined in the process. The trio soon discovers that the dark aura emitted by Arcane Demon Lord is connected to Hersh, confirming that he is one of the subordinates of Maxwell, the force that once invaded the Lotri Continent long ago. While Kareisha is planning their next route, Hersh blocks their path again. Acting impulsively, Sergio challenges Hersh to a one-on-one battle but is defeated. At a critical moment, Kareisha uses a replica Nado to distract Hersh, allowing the team to escape safely. After their escape, Sergio accidentally injures Kareisha, and under the influence of Maxwell’s dark power, Sergio begins to suffer from hallucinations.

videos.title: The Strongest of the Blazing Flame Tribe
videos.overview: To prevent Hersh from tracking their location through his mysterious connection with the Super Demon Lord, Kareisha and his team decide to head to the Tri-Border Market in search of materials that can block the Super Demon Lord’s signal. However, they are soon surrounded by Hersh. During the battle, Sergio chooses to fight alone. Pushed to his limits, he awakens his inner potential and temporarily suppresses Hersh, proving himself as the strongest of the Blazing Flame Tribe. But in the end, he exhausts all of his Spin Power. Just in time, Kareisha and Lacey rescue Sergio and escape in their RV. To shake off Hersh’s relentless pursuit, the trio has no choice but to enter the legendary Lost Cave, said to be haunted by monsters, planning to hide there first before mapping out a new route.

videos.title: The Wrath of the Shadow Hound King
videos.overview: After escaping into the Lost Cavern, Kareisha and his team are attacked by poisonous glowing mushrooms and a swarm of spiders inside the cave. Working together in perfect coordination, the trio uses their Nados to drive the spiders away. However, another danger soon appears—the beast known as the Shadow Hound King.This powerful creature can manipulate rock spikes, water currents, and electric shocks, and it even manages to seal the trio’s Nados. While observing the battle, Lacey discovers that the beast reacts instinctively to spherical mushrooms. Seizing this opportunity, the trio launches the mushrooms into the air to distract it.Through their combined efforts, they finally defeat the Shadow Hound King. After the beast disappears, it leaves behind a treasure box containing a special container capable of blocking the signal of the Super Demon Lord, along with an ancient electric-element component.

videos.title: Felix and Rosalba
videos.overview: After leaving the Lost Cavern, Kareisha and his team drive their RV into the Mushroom Forest, only to be ambushed once again by the Thunder Dragon Tribe assassin Hermina, who seeks revenge against Lacey because of an old grudge. During the battle, Hermina uses a tactic known as Resonance Modification, overwhelming the team and pushing them into a desperate situation. At the critical moment, Felix, a young warrior of the Thunder Dragon Tribe, appears and joins forces with Kareisha to drive Hermina away. After the battle, Felix reveals a token of the Thunder Dragon Tribe chieftain and explains that Lacey’s uncle has launched a rebellion, putting her father in grave danger. Determined to face the situation herself, Lacey refuses Felix’s offer of protection. Soon after, Rosalba, Hermina’s sister, suddenly appears. She presents a War Spirit Core infused with natural energy and warns Kareisha to protect Lacey well before disappearing.

videos.title: The Power of Modification
videos.overview: Beside a campfire in the wilderness, Kareisha studies Nado modification, trying to figure out how to counter Hermina’s “Resonance Modification” technique. His concentration is interrupted when Sergio, hungry and impatient, calls him to eat. While looking through an old photo album, the trio recalls Kareisha’s childhood, remembering how Yale once protected him when he was young. Soon after, Serlo suddenly appears with his followers. In the middle of the confrontation, Kareisha realizes the principle of balance modification while preparing roasted meat over the fire. Applying this insight during the battle, he swaps Nado parts mid-fight and successfully activates his own Resonance Modification technique. Working together with his two companions, they manage to defeat Serlo. Seeing an opportunity, Sergio tries to rescue his brother from the dark energy that has corrupted him. However, the dark power blocks his attempt, leaving Sergio helpless as he watches Serlo remain under its control.

videos.title: Redemption of the Traitor
videos.overview: Sergio has a nightmare in which his brother Serlo is harmed by Lacey and Kareisha. Startled awake, he falls under the influence of Maxwell and secretly runs away with the Super Demon Lord. However, he accidentally wanders into the territory of a Magnetic Bear. The Magnetic Bear manipulates magnetic fields and attacks using scattered metal parts, forcing Sergio into a fierce battle. Kareisha and Lacey soon arrive and join the fight. During the battle, they discover that the Magnetic Bear interferes with the trajectory of their Nados through its powerful magnetic field. Working together, the trio uses the unique strengths of their respective Nados to counter the Magnetic Bear’s steel-based attacks. In the end, they manage to drive the creature away. After the battle, Kareisha unexpectedly obtains a legendary Nado of the Sapiens Tribe. Sergio also confesses the truth that he had been influenced by Maxwell.

videos.title: Thunder Shaking the World
videos.overview: The team arrives in the Blazing Flame tribe's lands, and are on their way to the next possible spot of the Sacred Nado. Sergio says that Kareisha and Lacey are lucky to have him as guide. However Hersh is also there, though the same isn't applied for him. He and his gang are struggling to find the Blazing Flame Tribe's Capital, and wind up in the same spot. Luckily a member appears, and he tries to tell them that the map must be read in reverse but no one listens. Meanwhile, while driving Kareisha's van overheats. Which gives the team a chance to try the territory's mushrroms, though Sergio runs off to find one that makes the others edible. He finds the mushroom and runs back while being chased by wasps, and it helps Kareisha and Lacey who were feeling dizzy after eating the other mushrooms. Hersh then arrives, thanks to help from Serlo's raven, and a battle begins.

videos.title: Tears of the Fire-Eating Lizard
videos.overview: A mutated Fire-Eating Lizard attacks in dense fog. Lacey discovers a Water Attribute component lodged in its throat. After removing it, the creature returns to normal, revealing its aggression was a cry for help.

videos.title: Legend of the Rock Monster
videos.overview: Hersh and his subordinates return to their boss, after failing against Kareisha. Hersh explains to his boss that he was defeated after Kareisha got a new nado, and increased his strength. Hersh then says his combat power is too weak. But instead of punishment, his boss gives him a new mission. Hersh is to go to Crystal Cave, find a nado called "Shatter Wind Blast", and bring it back while both defeating the trio and getting Super Demon Lord.

videos.title: Beneath the Lava Falls
videos.overview: In the lava region, Hersh unleashes storm energy from his newly acquired Nado. Lacey cleverly provokes conflict between Hersh and Hermina, allowing the team to escape amid chaos.

videos.title: Outsmarting Master Keanie
videos.overview: In Tunnel, the team confronts Keanie, guardian of a lost Legendary Nado. Lacey synchronizes with natural wind energy to calm the storm. Keanie entrusts her with the Thunder Dragon Legendary Nado.
